# Font fixtures

`Tuffy.ttf` is covered by `LICENSE.txt`.

`JetBrainsMono-variable.ttf` is the unmodified JetBrains Mono upright variable
font from https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono/blob/master/fonts/variable/JetBrainsMono%5Bwght%5D.ttf,
retrieved 2026-10-13. Its `wght` axis spans 100–800 with default 400.
Redistribution and testing are covered by `JetBrainsMono-OFL.txt`.
